title: Present Simple: Wh- Questions and Information Questions
overview: Extend present-simple questions from yes/no questions to basic Wh- questions, using familiar daily-routine vocabulary and reinforcing Do/Does, base verbs, subject matching, and live in + place.
objectives: Understand the structure of basic present-simple Wh- questions.
Form What/Where/When/Why/Who questions with do/does when required.
Keep the main verb in the base form after do/does.
Answer basic information questions with short, clear sentences.
Reinforce the Unit 3 errors and spelling items scheduled for review.

new: Wh- question word meaning and selection

grammar_focus: What do you do every day?
Use do with I/you/we/they and does with he/she/it when the question requires an auxiliary.
Keep the main verb in base form after do/does.

vocabulary.theme: Daily routines and basic personal information

practice_grammar: Identify Wh- question words and their meanings.
Correct questions that incorrectly keep third-person -s after does.
Correct missing in in live in + place.
Answer Wh- questions using complete, understandable sentences.
practice_vocabulary: Use the new Wh- words in realistic daily-routine questions.
Use Unit 3 vocabulary in answers and short dialogues.
Reinforce the spelling of work and They and the capitalisation of TV.
output_requirements: Write at least five present-simple Wh- questions.
Answer at least five Wh- questions in complete sentences.
Use at least seven Unit 4 target/review vocabulary items in context.
Include at least one Where question using live in + place.
Include at least one When or Why question with does + base verb.

criteria: At least 8/10 Wh- question formation items correct.
No unresolved subject mismatch in targeted review items.
At least five understandable Wh- questions and answers.
Review spelling items are explicitly checked.
